Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 4014 of 2024
Applicant :- Ram Jagat
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.The Prin.Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Nijam Ahamad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.318 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Baskhari, District Ambedkar Nagar.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the sister of the informant was married to the applicant in the year 2018 and sufficient dowry was also given.
Subsequently, the entire matrimonial family had hanged her to death.
The FIR was lodged on 14.10.2023 i.e. after about seven days of the alleged incident.

The postmortem report on record indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and Ram Jagat vs State Of U.P. Thru.The Prin.Secy. Home ... on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141585599/

sentences.text: apart from the ligature mark, no other injury was visible on the body of the deceased.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the postmortem report and there being nothing on record to demonstrate that soon before the death, the victim was subjected to any physical or mental harassment in relation to demand of dowry at the instance of the applicant, as such, the applicant who is husband and is in custody since 18.10.2023 and has no criminal history, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Ram Jagat be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
